name: View tools
description: Values only, more Reference windows and Reset rotation, each with a switch of its own. What you save and export stays as it is.

controls.label: Value check
controls.description: Values only, in Actions > Canvas or on Alt+G, shows the canvas in greys to check its values, on the screen alone: what you save, export and pick stays in colour.

controls.label: Reference windows
controls.description: More than one Reference window open at once: + on a window opens another, each showing the canvas or a picture of its own, kept with the artwork.

controls.label: Rotation reset
controls.description: Reset rotation, in Actions > Canvas or on Alt+R, turns the canvas upright or to the nearest right angle. Switches keep pinching from turning it, and a quick pinch from fitting it to the screen.

controls.label: No fit on a quick pinch
